description: This file provides support for integrating with Vercel AI Gateway's `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint. It defines configuration, request transformation, and model retrieval methods specific to Vercel's API, extending OpenAI-compatible classes and adding Vercel-specific parameters and behavior.

classes.name: VercelAIGatewayConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Vercel AI Gateway that extends OpenAI GPT configuration, providing custom methods for provider info, request transformation, and model listing.

methods.name: Optional[str] custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Property returning the identifier for this provider, set as 'vercel_ai_gateway'.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters, adding 'extra_body' if not present.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Retrieves the provider's API base URL and API key from secrets or defaults.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps parameters for OpenAI API requests, adding Vercel-specific parameters.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms request parameters into the format suitable for the Vercel API.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns the exception class to use for errors, specific to Vercel Gateway.

methods.name: List[str] get_models( self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Retrieves available models from Vercel API.
